title: Example 1: four forklift criteria

source.citation: Pamucar, D., Stevic, Z., Sremac, S. (2018). A new model for determining weight coefficients of criteria in MCDM models: Full Consistency Method (FUCOM). Symmetry, 10(9), 393.
source.note: Read from the publisher's open-access HTML (CC BY). Table 1 is an image in that version; the comparative priorities are taken from the text of Step 3.

weights.printedIn: Example 1, final values of the weight coefficients

notes: Criteria are ranked C1 > C2 > C3 > C4. The text gives the comparative priorities phi_C1/C2 = 1.08, phi_C2/C3 = 1.25, phi_C3/C4 = 1.45 and the transitive products w1/w3 = 1.35 and w2/w4 = 1.81.
The text of Step 3 refers to "Table 2" for these relations; Table 2 belongs to Example 2, so this is a cross-reference slip in the paper.

Because each transitive constraint is the product of two adjacent ones, the chain w_k = phi_k/(k+1) * w_(k+1) satisfies every constraint exactly and chi = 0. The optimisation model therefore has a unique solution here.
